title: Surface Field
description: A themeable field of dots and lines that makes room around surfaces, bends as they move, and is lit by a light that follows the pointer.

loop.script: click[2] → wait → click[3] → wait → click[4] → wait → click[1] → wait

props.name: gap
props.description: Grid spacing in px.

props.name: focusRadius
props.description: Radius of the moving spotlight in px.

props.name: lineRadius
props.description: Independent reach of the connected lines, in px.

props.name: maxOpacity
props.description: Dot opacity at the focal centre.

props.name: baseOpacity
props.description: Faint dot opacity far from the focal.

props.name: tint
props.description: Maximum blend toward the tint colour at the focal centre. 0 disables it.

props.name: tintVar
props.description: CSS custom property read for the colour of the light. It is read from the field's own element, so a value on the root or on any ancestor applies.

props.name: tintHueVar
props.description: A registered <angle> property the light's hue follows (read from the field's element); when set, tintVar is ignored.

props.name: tintHue
props.description: The hue the light rests at, in degrees, before the angle from tintHueVar is added.

props.name: rippleSpeed
props.description: Speed of a press ripple's crest, in px per millisecond.

props.name: rippleWidth
props.description: Thickness of the ripple's crest in px.

props.name: surfacePadding
props.description: Signed px added to the empty fade around surfaces. The surface itself stays clear at every value.

props.name: rippleBoost
props.description: Maximum extra opacity a passing crest adds. 0 disables the lift.

props.name: rippleGrow
props.description: Maximum extra dot radius, in px, a passing crest adds.

props.name: ripplePush
props.description: Maximum outward displacement of a dot at the crest, in px. 0 keeps the grid rigid.

props.name: cursorPush
props.description: Peak displacement, in px, of the resting mouse pointer's local field.

props.name: cursorPushRadius
props.description: Reach of the pointer's local displacement in px; its light keeps focusRadius.

props.name: ripple
props.type: { x: number; y: number; at: number } | null
props.description: Drops one ring at (x, y), in px from the field's own box, for each new value of at. null never fires.

props.name: interactionRoot
props.description: When set, a primary press inside it holds its ripple until release; presses outside it do not start one.

props.name: controller
props.description: The instance-owned input channel from createSurfaceFieldController(): setScene, setFootprint, setPreview, setViewport, setLinks and refreshTheme, none of which render React.

props.name: containerRef
props.description: The field's outer element.

props.name: connected
props.description: Draw a fine orthogonal fabric of lines between the displaced dots, on a second canvas.

props.name: breathe
props.description: Share of dots (0 to 1) that slowly fade out and back, so the grid has grain. 0 turns it off.

props.name: breatheRate
props.description: Speed multiplier for the breathing dots.

props.name: still
props.description: Render a texture: every dot at maxOpacity, no light and no pointer listeners. It can still breathe.

props.name: wander
props.description: Let the light drift on its own while the window has focus; false makes it follow the pointer only and lets the loop sleep.

props.name: viewport
props.type: { x: number; y: number; zoom: number }
props.description: The host's camera, React Flow semantics: the grid pans 1:1 with it and scales with parallax. controller.setViewport is the per-frame path and wins once used.

props.name: className
props.description: Class names for the outer element, which sets the field's size and position (the field fills it).

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the outer element. Its colour is the dots' ink; the field forces pointer-events: none and overflow: hidden.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Replaces the faint dot grid shown before the first frame, in the server render and where there is no 2D canvas. It fades out once the field is drawing.

a11y: Decorative: the root is aria-hidden, holds no text and is never focusable, and it never intercepts the pointer, so the content above it keeps every event.
Reduced motion: the field is drawn once, centred, with no light, drift, breathing or pointer following (it follows a change of the system setting while mounted).

Touch and pen: a press drops the ring and moves the light to the contact point; mouse-only effects (cursorPush) ignore other pointer types. The field never captures a touch, so scrolling and pinch zoom are unaffected.
Drawing stops while the field is off screen or the tab is hidden, and the field gives its canvas memory back after four idle seconds.
The dots are ink at low opacity by design and carry no information. Under forced colors they take the system text color; raise maxOpacity or baseOpacity if a stronger texture is wanted.
docs:
Installed `SurfaceField` in `components/ui/`, its drawing engine in `lib/` (`surface-field-engine`, `surface-field-dom`, `surface-field-controller`, `surface-field-viewport`) and the `render-loop` helper. Put it in a box that has a size and a background, behind your content: ```tsx import { SurfaceField } from "@/components/ui/surface-field";
Your content
``` The field draws no background, never intercepts the pointer and is `aria-hidden`. Its dots take the colour of `--surface-field-ink` (falling back to the inherited text colour) and the light blends toward `--surface-field-tint`; both have light and dark values in your theme, and a `tint` of 0 turns the blend off. To make room around your own objects, create a controller once (`createSurfaceFieldController()`, kept in `useMemo`), pass it as `controller` and send rectangles with `controller.setScene({ root, rects })`, in CSS pixels relative to `root`; moving objects go through `setFootprint` without a React render. Scene coordinates are physical pixels and do not flip in right-to-left pages. Use `refreshTheme()` after changing the colour on an ancestor other than the document root. Drawing pauses off screen and in hidden tabs (the `render-loop` helper); under reduced motion the field is drawn once, with no light, drift or breath. Ported from angelolibero/surface-field (MIT, copyright 2026 Angelo Libero); the license text is in every file. Its `worker` prop is not ported: the field always draws on the main thread, through the render loop.
